def transform(grid):
    row_candidates = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    if row_candidates:
        row_sep = min(row_candidates, key=lambda r: abs(r - len(grid) // 2))
        a, b = grid[:row_sep], grid[row_sep + 1:]
        height = min(len(a), len(b))
        width = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
    else:
        col_candidates = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1]
        col_sep = min(col_candidates, key=lambda c: abs(c - len(grid[0]) // 2))
        a = [row[:col_sep] for row in grid]
        b = [row[col_sep + 1:] for row in grid]
        height = len(grid)
        width = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
    shared = set(value for row in a for value in row) & set(value for row in b for value in row)
    common = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == common and b[r][c] == common else common for c in range(width)] for r in range(height)]
